title: Explore the Data
text:
NoteProject Plan



I am planning to compare the top genres in songs from the Billboard Top 100 from the beginning and median years of each decade since the Billboard Top 100 has started. I am also going to find different impactful events from these years or surrounding years and see the impact on the popular genres during that time.
Below is the complete song-level dataset used in this project. You can sort, filter, or search for any artist, song, or genre across the tables below.
